0.0: So, you are covetous of intelligence as it pertains to Magnus and the central regions, yes? As much as it would please my tender sensibilities, I cannot simply give such valuable information away. T'would be a disgrace to my noble pursuit.
0.1: I therefore propose an exchange, a TRADE, if you will. Surely we can conduct such business in a civilized, amenable manner?
0.2: I ask only the completion of a single, elementary task. I hear your power is formidable, rendering this directive little more than a trifle.
0.3: For weapons both threatening and beautiful, there is no material more fervently sought than #b#t4033412##k. Bring me the paltry sum of #b50#k, and your precious data is yours!\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: Good luck then, dear guardian. I shall amuse myself with some light reading or a meditation on economic fundamentals. And forget not my need for #b50 of the precious #t4033412##k items, hmm? Seek your fortune among the #r#o2400105##k creatures of wild #b#m401030200##k.

no.0: My friend, surely you understand the fundamentals of good business! If you do not render a service, I can give you no good.

1.0: Have you come bearing my modest fee?

yes.0: Magnificent! Your desired knowledge shall be found within this missive, which you should take to #p3001002# with all due haste. Be on the prowl for further intelligence, and hesitate not to contact me for all your needs!

item.0: I have asked but 50 #b#t4033412##k items from the #r#o2400105##k monsters of #b#m401030200##k. There is no doubt that this is a fair and just price!
